jobs.title: Senior Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
📍 hybrid work - 3 days/week from the office Fabryczna Office Park, Krakow

Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
Experience building and running containerized applications
Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Microservices architecture and system design
Messaging and integration technologies: Kafka, IBM MQ, Tibco EMS
Relational databases: Azure SQL, Oracle, Sybase
Testing frameworks (unit, integration and E2E testing)
CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / GitHub)
Monitoring and observability practices

Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

jobs.title: Fullstackutvecklare inom C#NET sökes till Bliwa
jobs.description:
Om jobbet

I rollen som Fullstackutvecklare kommer du tillsammans med ditt team ansvara för underhåll, vidareutveckling och nyutveckling inom de delar teamet ansvarar för. Du samarbetar även tätt tillsammans med övriga IT-team och andra enheter i vår verksamhet. Säkerhet och kodkvalité är i fokus hos oss.

Din profil

Som person är du kommunikativ och validerar dina beslut med andra. Du trivs i en dynamisk miljö och att jobba tillsammans samtidigt som det är viktigt att du kan vara självgående.
Du känner dig trygg i rollen som utvecklare och din kompetens och förstår vikten av säkerhet genom hela applikationen. Du vågar lyfta problem, ifrågasätta processer och bidra med lösningar.

För att passa för rollen tror vi att du har:

Omkring 5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling med fokus på C# eller mer.
Erfarenhet av webbapplikationer i form av C# backend för affärslogik och API.er och frontend antingen i form av Blazor eller något JavavScript-ramverk.
Du har jobbat med och har god kunskap inom Azure – Bliwa har en Cloud First strategi och går nu mot en modern container baserad miljö i Azure. Allt vi bygger skapas upp med Infrastructure as Code med Terraform.
Erfarenhet med att jobba med SQL – vi använder både OnPrem SQL Server och SQL i Azure.
Då vi använder Azure Devops för repositories, CI/CD pipelines och Devops Boards för planering och utveckling enligt Kanban-flöde är det bra om du har erfarenhet av detta eller liknande.

Det här erbjuder vi dig

Som anställd på Bliwa blir du en del av ett härligt gäng med drygt 130 medarbetare. Kulturen präglas av samarbete och prestigelöshet och vi söker dig som trivs och växer bäst i team. Vi sitter i fina lokaler på Kungsholmen där vi gärna träffas för att lösa utmaningar tillsammans. Din arbetsplats är i första hand på kontoret då vi tror på värdet att ses, samtidigt som vi erbjuder möjlighet till viss flexibilitet.

Så söker du jobbet

Tjänsten är en tillsvidaretjänst på heltid och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Lotta Hörnfeldt på lotta.hornfeldt@bliwa.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken!

jobs.title: AI & AUTOMATION ENGINEER (LIEGE-BELGIUM)
jobs.description:
THE SCOPE

With 30 years of history, today Gaming1 is one of the international leaders in both land-based and online games of chance (casino games, sports betting and poker). Its evolution at the heart of innovation is accompanied by a diversification and specialization of positions, with the creation of new cutting-edge jobs.

As part of its IT Corporate Business Partners team, Gaming1 is looking for an AI & Automation Engineer
to design and operate automation solutions that serve the entire organisation. Your internal customers span Finance, HR, Marketing, Retail, and IT — with new use cases emerging constantly.

This is a greenfield role
. There is no legacy automation practice to maintain, no backlog of technical debt to inherit. You will help define what good looks like: the tools, the standards, the reusable components, the way we work. That means navigating ambiguity, learning fast, and making decisions without a complete picture — which is exactly what we are looking for.

This is a dual-focus role
: half automation engineering
(workflow design, integration, orchestration), half AI integration
(LLM-powered processing, intelligent document handling, smart routing). You will be expected to own both dimensions end-to-end — from a vague stakeholder conversation to a production deployment. Experiments will sometimes fail. We treat that as signal, not failure.

YOUR ROLE

Identify, scope, and prioritise automation opportunities across business domains (Finance, HR, Marketing, Retail, IT) in collaboration with stakeholders
Design and build production-grade automation workflows using Power Automate (Cloud), n8n, or any other tool fit for purpose
Develop and maintain REST API integrations (OAuth2, webhooks, JSON) or MCPs connecting internal tools and third-party services
Integrate LLM capabilities (Azure OpenAI or equivalent) into automation pipelines: document extraction, classification, email triage, exception handling
Write clean, maintainable scripts (Python, C#) for data transformation, validation logic, and automation tooling
Implement robust error handling, retry logic, alerting, and structured logging across all workflows
Document automations thoroughly and contribute to a growing framework of reusable components
Track and report automation KPIs: time saved, error reduction, volumes processed, ROI
Actively monitor the AI & automation landscape — bring relevant ideas to the table before you are asked

YOUR PROFILE

Required:

2–5 years of hands-on experience in automation engineering or a closely related role
Solid Power Automate (Cloud) skills: connector design, approval flows, complex conditional logic, SharePoint/M365 integrations
Strong REST API fundamentals: OAuth2, webhooks, pagination, authentication patterns, JSON manipulation
Python or C# proficiency: scripting for data handling, transformation logic, and automation support tasks
Practical LLM integration experience: prompt engineering for structured outputs, Azure OpenAI or OpenAI API usage in real workflows
Comfort with ambiguity: ability to turn a messy "this is painful" conversation into a scoped, maintainable solution
Strong ownership: you scope, build, test, deploy, and hand over — with documentation
Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken)

Nice to have:

Hands-on n8n experience: JavaScript nodes, custom HTTP integrations, self-hosted or cloud deployment
Familiarity with RAG patterns or MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Exposure to a regulated or compliance-heavy industry (gaming, finance, insurance)
DevOps literacy: Git, versioning, CI/CD pipelines
Knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem beyond Power Automate

What We Offer

As well as enjoying a unique experience – centered around our values of Pleasure, Team Spirit, Performance, Boldness and Integrity – alongside 1.600 colleagues worldwide, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the international development of a fast-growing family company.
Joining Gaming1 means becoming part of a human and entrepreneurial adventure where people are empowered to make an impact, grow and succeed together.
We offer:
the opportunity to work on ambitious international projects within a solid and growing group
a collaborative and high-performing work environment
leadership based on trust, autonomy, talent and shared values
continuous learning and career development opportunities through training and internal mobility
a competitive salary and benefits package aligned with the local market
a hybrid working model, with the possibility to work remotely up to 50% of your working time
an international and collaborative environment where people come first
